changes.rationale: Primary premarket release presents Neutrolin post-approval surveillance outcomes from routine use. This is human outcome evidence, but it is not identified as a controlled clinical-trial readout; old exclusion merely for not being pivotal is insufficient under class 3. Resolve clinical-data eligibility and direct jump attribution.

Primary patent announcement is February 26, after jump date; patent issuance itself is dated February 25. Public availability and price attribution on February 25 remain unverified, and patent issuance is not automatically a drug approval or technical breakthrough.
